name: Paper Toss VR
summary:
️ Classic Toss-'Em-Up Gameplay: Intuitive and satisfying. Easy to learn, challenging to master.

Multiple Diverse Environments: From the familiar Office to a Tropical Island, deep Space, and the focused Grid Gauntlet – there's a new challenge around every corner!

Physics-Based Fun: It's not just paper! Discover other perfectly throwable (and not-so-perfectly throwable) items.

A Perfect VR Break: Ideal for a quick, stress-relieving session or for dedicating time to climbing those high scores.
